cloud_milestone: Cloud 4 Free Edition nine-fold capacity gate

attempts.reason: Existing graph Delta tables had integer node IDs and rejected deterministic long hash IDs.
Combined preprocessing PipelineModel exceeded Spark Connect's 268435456-byte model limit (measured model sizes 301331888 and 291651456 bytes).
Standalone ImputerModel exceeded Spark Connect's 268435456-byte model limit (measured model sizes 313619848 and 316534656 bytes).
Standalone StandardScalerModel exceeded Spark Connect's 268435456-byte model limit (measured model sizes 294071464 and 347248992 bytes).

restartability.reason: Every attempt failed during graph-table preparation or first-fold preprocessing before the atomic fold checkpoint writes.

free_edition_viability.remaining_risk: Full-volume Spark ML estimator model responses may also exceed the fixed Spark Connect model-size ceiling.

exact_next_action: After review and explicit cloud-run approval, submit databricks/cloud4-first-fold-submit.json from the committed agent/cloud3-gold branch; resume the nine-fold job only if that gate fits the Spark Connect limit and reloads one complete restart checkpoint.
